name: gRPC Client
description: Load services from .proto, descriptor sets or server reflection, edit ProtoJSON and make unary and server-streaming calls with messages, status and metadata
help: Pick a definition source: local .proto files (imports are resolved in include-directory order, Google well-known types are built in), a FileDescriptorSet produced by protoc, or Server Reflection from a running server. Parsing and browsing local definitions works fully offline.
Write requests in ProtoJSON: 64-bit integers can be strings to keep their precision, bytes are base64 and enums accept names. Validate checks fields against the method's request type.
Plain addresses use HTTP/2 prior knowledge (h2c); with TLS on, certificates are checked against the system store and HTTP/2 is negotiated through ALPN. The deadline is sent as grpc-timeout.

Server-streaming messages appear as they arrive and can be cancelled at any time; by default up to 1000 messages or 16 MB are kept before the call ends early. Client and bidirectional streaming are not supported yet.
Metadata values marked as credentials are used only in this run: they never reach saved settings, task logs or exports.
